verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI feature is a one-line pricing-page mention of 'AI product classification' (numeral-docs-36), which implies AI-generated suggestions on product data. Conversational insights such as nexus and filing questions come through the official MCP server used from external AI clients like Claude or Cursor (numeral-docs-7, numeral-docs-30), not inside Numeral itself. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant or insight surface, documentation of how AI classification suggestions are generated and shown, AI-driven insights beyond classification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
